craft_notes: Sthāyin: moral inversion marveled. Device: semicolon→comma + dash→comma (ferment stated softly, hail lands). Rejected: softening kukarma — killed: filth aimed at him IS the verse's dare; kept. Rejected: 'cheers' for 'hail, ho!' — killed: bhoḥ kept as hail. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Foul aimed Godward ferments fine, fine elsewhere,
for elsewhere thou standest not so: hail, ho!
l4.sanskrit_cite: kukarmāpi yam uddiśya devaṃ syāt sukṛtaṃ param sukṛtasyāpi saukṛtyaṃ yato 'nyatra na so 'si bhoḥ

reads_against.argmap: Even evil deed aimed at which god would become supreme good.; Even good deed's goodness — since elsewhere you are not so, O! → Evil aimed at you becomes supreme; good is good only by you.
c1_essence: Flawless taproot sought by none; remembrance lucidity hymned.
reads_against.l2: Aim filth at him and it turns sterling; aim merit elsewhere — O, nowhere else such alchemy.
l3: Foul aimed Godward ferments fine; fine elsewhere —
for elsewhere thou standest not so: hail, ho!
reads_against.t1: Even evil deed aimed at which god would become supreme good; even good deed's goodness — since elsewhere you are not so, O!
